verdict.rationale: The ranking-and-relevance docs include a "Text Match Score & Type" section, which suggests Typesense exposes a text-match score a platform engineer could inspect. Nothing in the pack shows a per-result score breakdown or an explanation of why a result ranked where it did. missing for 10: documented per-hit score fields in search responses, a ranking explanation/debug mode showing each ranking criterion's contribution, coverage of how vector/hybrid scores are exposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
